outerClosure.interpretation: Node reports eight fixture finally closures and zero active Miniflare; Python still reports leftoverGroupKilled=true, attempted outer process-group cleanup, adopted and reaped four group descendants, and ultimately groupGone=true. Therefore wholly cooperative process-group closure is not established. Four waitStatus0 records prove normal recorded exits of those adopted descendants, not that SIGTERM killed a live process. killpg(group,0) may have detected zombies; the artifact contains no live/zombie census to distinguish them.

supported: Three native Node transport calibrations closed the incomplete SSE response and server peer as expected.

The frozen two-file baseline failed exactly the source cancellation null assertion; changing reader transport, explicit RST, or the isolated signal passthrough variant did not produce the source cancel KV observation in the original or tail windows.

RST has one holder request.signal abort logged about1.338ms after client cancel settled by host receive time, seconds before the conservative dispose bracket. This particular abort belongs to the captured client-cancel period, not a dispose-only interpretation.

The four observed cases captured accepted KV put invocation and fulfillment. They captured zero cancel-category KV invocation/fulfillment and zero waitUntil registration/settlement. Therefore this artifact provides no positive proof of source cancel callback entry; it does not establish a later or unlogged callback is impossible.

Destroy, reader-cancel and passthrough-destroy continued sampled release reads through300 and then logged synthetic stream release timeout before dispose. RST captured only initial release read and holder abort; missing later samples are not a proof of exact termination.
notEstablished: An upstream runtime defect or specific workerd frame teardown path is not causally proven.
A Service Binding-only defect is not proven without a matched no-binding/direct-holder runtime comparison.
Signal abort cannot satisfy or substitute for the original source cancel KV assertion.
Zero waitUntil logs cannot diagnose lost waitUntil persistence when its invocation itself has no positive captured evidence.
Outer killed flag cannot be omitted, interpreted as proven live-process termination, or upgraded to wholly cooperative native closure.

nextDiagnosticPlan.scope: New owned diagnostic only, same locked workerd1.20260828.1/Miniflare5.20260828.0-alpha/compatibility date2026-09-04 and original configured flags. Freeze original sources/expectations and keep their baseline once, preserving actual1.

arms.name: locked-no-binding-async-source
arms.difference: A single local Worker has no Service Binding. Match the existing synthetic SSE first frame, async pull KV/timer pattern, highWaterMark0, source cancel KV put and original waitUntil registration semantics; use destroy and RST as two labeled comparisons.
arms.purpose: Test whether the same locked runtime can lose source cancel at a direct HTTP async-source boundary without any binding.

arms.name: locked-direct-original-holder-with-gateway-envelope
arms.difference: In a new local single-worker diagnostic wrapper, construct the private URL Request with the same six-field body, Content-Type, body stream and explicit incoming signal as the frozen gateway, then invoke frozen original holder.fetch directly with the owned KV/env/context. Retain the same Response(body) rewrap as the original gateway; remove only Service Binding transport. Private holder source remains frozen. This diagnostic bundle contains synthetic holder literals and is baselineEligible=false, with no production exposure.
arms.purpose: Compare gateway-shaped forwarding and frozen holder semantics without a Service Binding; this is a diagnostic topology variant, not a replacement production gateway or original test.

preserve: Original baseline raw TAP and exit; all original assertions remain unchanged.
HTTP200, exact text/event-stream and first frame; accepted one/release null; source cancel observed within original100 polls/10ms; four-second tail stays separate and cannot pass.
No abort handler may write cancel KV, cancel the stream, or provide alternate success. No runtime/flag/dependency upgrade.
Add explicit host dispose-start/dispose-settled events and phase to worker log receipts; obtain final pre-dispose KV snapshot before shutdown. Attribute shutdown-only aborts separately.

Outer executor remains authoritative; record a bounded owned-process-group /proc state census before any kill and actual adopted wait statuses to distinguish live from zombie candidates without changing this first run forced flag.
All direct variants labeled separately; a passing direct arm cannot upgrade original Service Binding baseline.
decisionRules: If bare no-binding and direct-holder both fail at the same source-cancel boundary, the binding-only explanation weakens but an upstream regression still needs a pinned corrected-runtime or direct locked-source trace comparison.

If direct-holder passes and binding arm still fails, isolate response-body forwarding and binding serialization with a further matched intermediate arm; do not claim global binding failure from this one workload.
If logs capture cancel KV invoke but not settlement, investigate KV lifetime/persistence; if no positive invocation capture, focus on source callback/stream pump entry and instrumentation coverage.
